titulo: Escudos originales para Champions Fútbol Prohibido
nota: Los clubes son referencias de inspiración. Los números de archivo identifican los diseños y no asignan números a los equipos del torneo.
prompt_base: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: ONE original football team crest for the Champions Fútbol Prohibido Roblox tournament gallery. Create a single finished crest on a square canvas with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Style: premium contemporary classic football heraldry, crisp vector-like geometric edges, clean flat solid-color fields, bold consistent outlines, balanced symmetry, restrained emblematic detail, strong silhouette readable at 64 pixels. All 48 badges in this collection must have uniform professional quality and visual weight. Framing: full crest centered, occupying about 82 percent of square canvas height, comfortable transparent padding on all sides, flat front view. Text: NONE. Absolutely NO names, letters, initials, digits, dates, monograms, text banners, watermark or signature. No background plate, scene, mockup, cast shadow, photograph, texture or 3D rendering. Invent an original composition inspired by the club's colors and heraldic vocabulary rather than reproducing its official badge.
sufijo_prompt: Club reference: {club}. Design direction: {design}. Output exactly ONE individual crest, never a collage or contact sheet.

escudos.prompt_override: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one original football team crest for a Roblox tournament gallery. Generate ONE single crest on a square 1024 by 1024 canvas with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Inspiration: Manchester United's scarlet red, black and warm gold football heraldry, but invent an original composition rather than reproducing the club badge. Design: a compact angular pointed shield, scarlet field, bold black and ivory border, a clean gold three-pronged spear rising behind a small black-and-ivory football. Contemporary classic football heraldry, exceptionally crisp flat vector-like geometry, solid colors, balanced symmetry, restrained detail, strong silhouette readable at 64 pixels. Center the fully visible crest occupying about 82 percent of canvas height, with comfortable transparent padding on all sides. Flat front view. This is the first of a coherent set of 48 badges: professional, collectible, clean and uniform visual weight. Absolutely NO text, names, letters, initials, digits, monograms, dates, words, banners for text, watermarks, signatures, background plate, shadows, mockup, photographic texture, 3D effect or gradients. Do not add lettering even as decoration. Output only the single finished transparent crest.
